dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Firearm maintenance... Owww, my head's killing me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your gun...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Ah... This is a musket made in Fontaine. I bought it off a bunch of merchants from Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with your head?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Ow, ow... My head hurts... I must have drank too much last night...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Captain Lohen and Siegfria mustn't see me like this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your scar...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Ah... this isn't just some scrape I got from getting drunk and falling over somewhere. This is actually a "badge of honor" for a Knight of the expeditionary force!!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: "A wound taken in battle is not a badge of shame, but a badge of honor!" ...Besides, doesn't its position make me look a little like the Grand Master? Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All the best to you...

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: You too, Honorary Knight...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A musket from Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Yeah... And since we burn through muskets really quickly on the field, we need to choose models that we have the parts to maintain — especially on long expeditions.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: While 5th Coy has its own ranged weapons, we don't have a stable source for them in Nod-Krai... which is why we also procure generic models manufactured elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Captain Lohen always says that weapons are just like methods... anything goes, so long as it achieves the goal. If it doesn't feel right, it just means you haven't practiced enough with it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Merchants from Snezhnaya?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Not everyone from Snezhnaya attacks on sight! We've worked with people from Snezhnaya many times during our expeditions.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: All I can say is that there are way too many factions in their ranks and there're good eggs and bad eggs everywhere... You get that, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: As for the merchants who sold me the gun... I feel that they're really good people!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: ...Because the Fire-Water that they delivered along with the musket tasted both sincere and fiery!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Captain Lohen?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Lohen is the Vice Captain of the 5th Company... Though honestly, he might as well be our Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if you've heard already, but Captain Lohen's as merciless as a howling blizzard toward his enemies. The way he treats his subordinates, on the other hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...is as warm and gentle as the spring breeze?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: No, he's still as cold as a blizzard. Just recalling it has sobered me right up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Siegfria?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: That's my younger sister, and she still lives over in Springvale. She used to feed me a whole heap of wild vegetables to sober me up whenever I drank too much.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: ...It's not like she even had enough wild vegetables for herself. *sigh* And now I miss her wild vegetable soup.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: If you have the time, Honorary Knight... would you do me the favor of dropping in on her the next time you pass by Springvale?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Turn, left... turn, right!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Honorary Knight, feel like helping me get them cleaned up?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh, just some Knights of Favonius formation drills. These three overdid it last night, so I'm sobering them up.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...And rooting out the worst offender while I'm at it, whose grand prize will be 20 laps. The expeditionary force is allowed to drink liquor, but ground rules stand for when and how much you drink.

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: I—I only had a little bit!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Save the excuses, prove it with your feet! Show me you can nail a picture-perfect parade-ground pivot while you're plastered!
